text: I'm a childminder and I've got a little girl overnight, she's 14 months. Temp 38.8 when I checked just now. She was sick once around tea time but she's kept her milk and water down fine since. While I was changing her I noticed some little purple-red spots on her legs, and a couple of bigger bruisey looking marks. I pressed a glass on them like you're meant to and they didn't go. Her neck's fine, she was bending down looking at her toes when I put her socks back on. Might be silly but her mum said to ring someone if I wasn't sure, and I'm not sure.
